item.title: Hisbah Arrests Nine Muslims For Breaking Ramadan Fast In Kano State
item.description: Nine Muslims are detained in Kano for eating during Ramadan, while authorities teach fasting and Quranic lessons.

item.title: Trump Positions Board Of Peace As Global Power Shift Away From The United Nations
item.description: Trump frames Gaza reconstruction board as new global model, sidelining UN and reshaping Middle East diplomacy.

item.title: Trump Declares End Of Gaza War, Unveils $17bn Reconstruction And Security Plan
item.description: Trump announces Gaza war’s end, launching multibillion-dollar rebuilding and international stabilisation strategy.

item.title: Rivers Assembly Withdraws Appeals Against Governor Fubara, Deputy
item.description: Lawmakers withdraw appeal suits against Governor Fubara and his deputy following presidential intervention and fresh constitutional undertakings.

item.title: Senate Threatens To Cut N58.472tn 2026 Budget Over Unrealistic Revenue Projections
item.description: The Senate has warned that it may trim the N58.472trn 2026 budget, citing rising debt and poor capital implementation.

item.title: ADC Condemns Tinubu’s Assent To Electoral Act, Says President Has Signed Death Warrant Of Credible Elections
item.description: ADC says by signing the controversial electoral act amendment bill, Tinubu signed the "death warrant" of credible elections in Nigeria.

item.title: Lifted By Forex Inflows, Naira Set To Strengthen Further, Says Reuters Report
item.description: According to a Reuters report, the Naira is expected to extend gains on stronger forex inflows and CBN interventions

item.title: NAFDAC Impounds N100m Worth Of Expired Food Products In Niger State
item.description: NAFDAC has sealed at least 18 warehouses in Niger state after uncovering expired food products valued above N100m.

item.title: President Of Sierra Leone Julius Maada Bio Confers National Honours On Two Senior Nigerian Military Officers
item.description: Sierra Leone’s President has conferred honours on two Senior Nigerian defence chiefs for their role during the country’s civil war.

item.title: Lagos Unveils Wealth Fund Architecture To Drive Infrastructure, Tech Investment
item.description: Lagos state government has proposed the Lagos State Wealth Fund which targets infrastructure, innovation, fiscal stability and long-term savings.
